name: stress-ng vecmath
description: Start N workers that perform various unsigned integer math operations on various 128 bit vectors. A mix of vector math operations are performed on the following vectors: 16 x 8 bits, 8 x 16 bits, 4 x 32 bits, 2 x 64 bits and where supported 1 x 128 bits. The metrics produced by this mix depend on the processor architecture and the vector math optimisations produced by the compiler. The score is the total bogo operations per second (in real time) based on wall clock run time.

environment_fields.kernel_version: Linux kernel version of the server running the benchmark (not recorded for managed databases).
environment_fields.measured_at: Timestamp (UTC) of finishing the benchmark run.
